characters.name: Brave Survivor

inventory.name: Code Fragments
inventory.description: Three matched symbols and a final fragment etched in golden fire from the Awakened Fruit. Burns in memory—cannot be dropped or stolen.

goals: Survive the four-way war now spreading across the entire city grid
Determine which side the Ancient Watcher has chosen
Protect the code fragments from enemies who seek to purge them
Find safety beyond the collapsing bunker perimeter
Understand the Watcher's ancient purpose

Awakened Fruit expended—no more golden fire or frequency power
Entity sealed the bunker behind—no retreat possible
Four-way war now raging across the city grid
Ancient Watcher descending and has chosen an unknown side
Darkness still orchestrating from everywhere
The Rival's missile pods reloaded above

characters.name: The Rival

inventory.name: Missile Pods

goals: Purge the revealed code fragments before they can be used

Control the expanded battlefield across the city grid
obstacles: Brave Survivor escaped and is now in the open city
Awakened Fruit's frequency may be lost—missile lock compromised
Massive Entity sealed below but still roaring
Ancient Watcher descending as fourth player
Darkness orchestrating the four-way war
City grid trembling—unstable terrain for missile deployment

locations.name: Hidden Bunker
locations.description: A consumed warzone, now sealed shut. The Entity's claw slammed against stone like a coffin lid. No way back. No way down. The obby gate shattered and was escaped through, but the Entity sealed the entrance behind. Silence reigns below as the Entity rages in its prison.
obstacles: Massive Entity sealed inside—trapped but still active
Entrance collapsed and sealed by Entity's claw
Darkness's influence may seep through cracks
War rages on above even as the bunker falls silent
rewards: Mystery code fully solved—fragments preserved in Survivor's memory
Obby gate shattered—proof the impossible was accomplished
Survivor escaped with code fragments intact

locations.name: Grid-based City
locations.description: The main city where players interact and play. Now trembling beneath an unblinking ancient gaze. The battlefield has expanded from one consumed bunker to the entire grid. Cracked pavement. Collapsed walls. Missile pods reloading in the sky. And something ancient descending through fractured clouds.

locations.name: Obby
locations.description: A challenging obstacle course conquered under fire. The final gate shattered under golden fire from the Awakened Fruit. The Survivor leaped through as the Entity's claw slammed shut behind. The gate is broken. The escape achieved. But the war follows through the shattered remains.
locations.difficultyLevel: Completed—gate shattered with seconds to spare
locations.timeLimit: No limit—the gate is destroyed, the war continues

plot.mainQuest: Survive the four-way war spreading across the entire city grid, determine the Ancient Watcher's chosen allegiance, protect the code fragments from all factions, and find a path forward now that retreat is impossible
plot.timeLimit: No formal time limit—the bunker is sealed, the war continues across the city grid
plot.consequencesOfFailure: Darkness consumes everything through its orchestrated four-way war; the Ancient Watcher's ancient purpose and chosen side reshapes the conflict; code fragments are lost to enemies; the sealed Entity breaks free and consumes the city; the Survivor has nowhere left to run
plot.currentState: Brave Survivor lies against cracked pavement, shoulder screaming, code fragments burning in memory. The bunker is sealed behind—the Entity's claw a coffin lid. The silence lasted three heartbeats. Then the Ancient Watcher blinked. Twice. Stone eyes older than the city itself. Its massive form descended through fractured clouds, ancient code pulsing across its chest like a heartbeat. The Rival's missile pods reloaded above. The Entity roared from below. Darkness watched from everywhere. And the Watcher—descending—had chosen its side. No one knew which one yet. The war is no longer three-sided. Something older has awakened. The battlefield is the city now.
